mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a recessionary demand shock, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) when GDPC1 falls below -2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage inflation and input costs, compressing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5% for three consecutive months signals improving supply conditions and cost pressures, which can erode profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in late-cycle environments.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is above its 12-month MA by >1.5% for three months in late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS above their respective 12-month averages by at least 0.5% in the same month signals strong labor market momentum, which boosts consumer spending but also wage inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 12-mo MA +0.5% AND PAYEMS > 12-mo MA +0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive during months when both UNRATE and PAYEMS exceed their 12-month averages by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in HOUST below its 6-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months when HOUST is below its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% while CPIAUCSL rises above 3% for two consecutive months signals a monetary policy-lag environment where inflation is outpacing policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate future rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND CPIAUCSL > 3% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive during months when FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL > 3% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in RSAFS above 8% signals robust retail demand growth, which correlates with higher corporate revenues in consumer-facing sectors and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are not significantly positive during months when RSAFS increases by more than 8% year-over-year.
